learning_outcomes.text: Students master the essential fundamentals of system theory.
They know the mathematical description of signals and systems in the time domain and their essential characteristics.
They know the basics of probability theory and can calculate with discrete and continuous random variables.
They understand the basic concepts of information theory and can apply them.

syllabus_topics: Signals, characteristic values and properties of signals, elementary operations, signal synthesis and signal analysis, periodic signals, analog-digital and digital-analog conversion, linear and non-linear systems
Introduction and definitions, multi-stage random experiments, discrete random variables, continuous random variables
Fundamental questions of information theory, entropy concepts, applications
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam.
